title: Scheme and geometric Frobenius of the purity datum
statement:
In the purity conventions of this chapter ([def-pur-conventions]), fix the
global finite-field datum
$(p,a,q,k_0,k)$, and let $f_0:X_0\to Y_0$ be a
finite-type separated
morphism of $k_0$-schemes whose base change to $k$ is smooth of relative
dimension $d$. Put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and
let $f:X\to Y$ be the base change of $f_0$. With
$\gamma=\operatorname{Frob}_q=\sigma^{-1}$ in the
geometric Frobenius convention of
the framework chapter, write

$$
g_{X,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\Spec(\gamma),\
g_{Y,\gamma}=\operatorname{id}_{Y_0}\times\Spec(\gamma),
$$

for the semilinear (geometric-Galois) automorphisms, and let $\Phi_X$,
$\Phi_Y$ be the base changes to $X$ and $Y$ of the absolute $q$-power
Frobenius maps $F_{X_0}^{(q)}:X_0\to X_0$ and
$F_{Y_0}^{(q)}:Y_0\to Y_0$ [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme],
formed using [def-pc-base-change]; they form the following commutative
squares:

$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X & \xrightarrow{\ g_{X,\gamma}\ } & X\\
f\downarrow & & \downarrow f\\
Y & \xrightarrow{\ g_{Y,\gamma}\ } & Y,
\end{array}
\qquad
\begin{array}{ccc}
X & \xrightarrow{\ \Phi_X\ } & X\\
f\downarrow & & \downarrow f\\
Y & \xrightarrow{\ \Phi_Y\ } & Y;
\end{array}
$$

the first square is Cartesian, since its horizontal arrows are the
compatible semilinear automorphisms. The second is commutative by the
affine description of the absolute Frobenius in [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]; it
is not asserted to be Cartesian, and the scheme-Frobenius forms are
transported from the first square using the comparison isomorphisms, not
by applying Cartesian base change to the second square. The comparison
isomorphisms $\kappa_X,\kappa_Y$ are defined explicitly below (this
construction applies to the displayed schemes without assuming that their
structure morphisms are finite type): the absolute Frobenius
factorizes as

$$
\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{Y/k}=g_{Y,\sigma}\Phi_Y=\Phi_Yg_{Y,\sigma}
$$

(the affine factorization is verified in the proof below, with
$\sigma:z\mapsto z^q$ the arithmetic Frobenius), so the scheme Frobenius and the geometric-Galois
automorphism $g_{Y,\gamma}=g_{Y,\sigma}^{-1}$ differ by the universal
homeomorphism $\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{Y/k}$, under which the etale site
is invariant by [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance].
The isomorphisms are compatible with the pullback-composition
identifications and with $f$:

$$
Lf^*\kappa_Y=\kappa_XLf^*.
$$

Here $\operatorname{Fr}^{(q)}_{T/k}$ in the displayed factorization denotes the absolute morphism $F_T^{(q)}$, not the relative $k$-linear Frobenius [def-weil-absolute-frobenius-scheme]. All comparisons in this finite-coefficient datum are on $D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, where $A=A_{E,n}$ is fixed by [def-pur-conventions]. For $T=X,Y$ the comparison is explicitly
$$
 \kappa_T:L\Phi_T^*\cong L(F_T^{(q)})^*Lg_{T,\gamma}^*
 \xrightarrow{\tau_T^{(a)}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*,
$$
where $\tau_T^{(a)}$ is the canonical trivialization of [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback]. The construction uses the canonical relative-Frobenius trivialization specified in [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback]; it is defined for the displayed $k_0$-schemes even when only $f_0$, rather than their structure morphisms, is assumed finite type. The maps $\Phi_T$ are defined by base-changing $F_{T_0}^{(q)}$ [def-pc-base-change], which requires no absolute finite-type assumption.

For clarity, if $c_\Phi:Lf^*L\Phi_Y^*\cong L\Phi_X^*Lf^*$ and $c_g:Lf^*Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*\cong Lg_{X,\gamma}^*Lf^*$ denote the identifications from the two commuting squares, the last formula means the equality of natural transformations
$$
 c_g\circ(Lf^*\kappa_Y)=(\kappa_XLf^*)\circ c_\Phi.
$$
The first square is the square of [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian]. The universal-homeomorphism assertion is [lem-pur-absolute-frobenius-universal-homeomorphism]; its etale-site consequence and the canonical pro-etale Frobenius trivialization are separate inputs.

proof.text: Define $g_{T,\gamma}=\mathrm{id}_{T_0}\times\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma)$ for $T=X,Y$. The statement of [lem-weil-frobenius-square-cartesian], applied to the given $k_0$-morphism $f_0$, supplies the inverse maps, the commutativity $fg_{X,\gamma}=g_{Y,\gamma}f$, and exactly the first Cartesian square. Its hypotheses require neither properness nor smoothness nor absolute finite type.

proof.text: For a model T0, check each factorization after the two projections of its chosen base change. Naturality of absolute Frobenius gives the first-projection equations. The second projection is Spec(k); arithmetic coefficient Frobenius acts by the qth power on k, so the second-projection equations follow from the global-sections Frobenius formula and preservation of powers by ring maps. Pullback uniqueness gives both arithmetic factorizations. Composing the second with the inverse geometric coefficient action gives Phi = F followed by g_gamma. This works for arbitrary models and requires no affine-cover or affine-spectrum tensor-product identification.

source.place: definition, order 2579; explicit verification of its embedded assertions

proof.text: Regard $T=X,Y$ as $k_0$-schemes via their maps to $\operatorname{Spec}k$. By [lem-pur-absolute-frobenius-universal-homeomorphism], $F_T^{(q)}$ is a universal homeomorphism without any finiteness hypothesis on $T_0$. Applying [thm-weil-pbc-universal-homeomorphism-invariance] gives the asserted invariance of the small etale topos. This step supplies the etale assertion only; the next step uses the specified pro-etale trivialization instead of inferring one from an unspecified equivalence.

source.place: definition, order 2579; explicit verification of its embedded assertions

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback] at exponent $a$ and with the coefficient ring $A$ to obtain $\tau_T^{(a)}:L(F_T^{(q)})^*\cong\mathrm{id}$. Derived pullback for constant coefficients is the exact inverse image applied to complexes, by [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. The canonical isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition], applied to the constant coefficient sheaves and their composite identifications, gives pullback-composition for the equality $\Phi_T=g_{T,\gamma}F_T^{(q)}$ of step 2, followed by $\tau_T^{(a)}Lg_{T,\gamma}^*$, therefore defines the displayed $\kappa_T$. Both arrows are isomorphisms. This explicitly fixes the comparison rather than choosing an arbitrary equivalence. The formula uses the canonical relative-Frobenius construction, so it also specifies which comparison is meant in the referenced comparison interface.

source.place: definition, order 2579; explicit verification of its embedded assertions

proof.text: For $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{proet}},A)$, identify both sources in the claimed compatibility with $L(F_X^{(q)})^*Lg_{X,\gamma}^*Lf^*K$, using the factorization and the two commuting squares. The naturality formula of [lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback] with $u=f$, $b=a$, evaluated at $Lg_{Y,\gamma}^*K$, says that applying $Lf^*\tau_Y^{(a)}$ is the same as applying $\tau_X^{(a)}$ after the composition comparison. Whiskering by the comparison $c_g$ and using naturality of $\tau_X^{(a)}$ gives exactly $c_g\circ Lf^*\kappa_Y=(\kappa_XLf^*)\circ c_\Phi$. The remaining arrows are composition isomorphisms of [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]; on a K-flat complex with flat terms each is the termwise canonical isomorphism of module pullbacks, so any two composites of them between the same functors, formed for the equal morphisms $f\circ g_{X,\gamma}\circ F_X^{(q)}=g_{Y,\gamma}\circ F_Y^{(q)}\circ f=\Phi_Y\circ f=f\circ\Phi_X$, agree; this is the coherence used when $c_\Phi$ is compared with $c_g$, $c_{f,a}$ and the two factorization isomorphisms. This proves the stated shorthand $Lf^*\kappa_Y=\kappa_XLf^*$ with all domains identified.

split_report.summary: Followed main-20261015. Defined all four maps by base change, cited the existing Cartesian-square lemma, verified commutation and factorization on section maps, separated etale invariance from pro-etale trivialization, and typed the comparison compatibility. Added the general pullback-naturality lemma and a closed Lean attachment node for absolute finite-field Frobenius being a universal homeomorphism; no finite-type hypothesis was silently added to X_0 or Y_0. Removed the unused direct twist dependency.
split_report.blueprint: Realizes the maps, the two squares, absolute Frobenius factorization, comparison isomorphisms and final pullback compatibility of main-20261015 def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius (order 2579). The definition has no source proof file; its assertions are verified in five steps. The current source files this definition under sk-def-sf-weil-complexes; inherited chapter/unit metadata is left unchanged.

tool_uses.why: Its canonical composition comparison for derived pullbacks with identified ring sheaves is a generic ringed-site tool used to type kappa; this definition introduces no competing composition construction.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q18-0ae63767b (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Read in full: the item, both new nodes, every cited statement, main-20261015 def-pur-scheme-geometric-frobenius (order 2579), Stacks 0CC8 (varieties lemma-frobenius, no hypotheses on X) and 0F6W (more-morphisms lemma-relative-frobenius-weakly-etale), and the Lean candidate IsFrobenius.isUniversalHomeomorphism (Morphisms/Frobenius.lean:149-168, no finiteness assumption, sorry map s:false ts:false). The worker's scope dispute is right: def-trf-scheme-frobenius, prop-trf-frobenius-factorization and prop-trf-scheme-galois-comparison all need finite-type X_0, but the item only makes f_0 finite type. The repair keeps the source's formulas: Phi = F_{T0}^(q) x id, the factorization is proved directly on affines (b⊗c -> b^q⊗c^q), and kappa = (tau^(a) Lg^*) composed with the pullback-composition isomorphism for Phi = g_gamma F. No hypothesis was added and nothing was weakened. The maps match the source exactly and the coefficient category is A = A_{E,n} on D(T_proet,A). Citers use this item's kappa, so none breaks. Every citation is on the sk-thm-sf-package route, and there is no SGA. Small cases (empty, nonreduced, infinite disjoint unions, b=0, u=id, Spec k_0 with a>1) pass. Neither new node is a duplicate, and neither restates a clause of the item. Two repairs, files in fixes/: (1) B2/E5 in lem-pur-frobenius-trivialization-pullback: tau^(b) was defined twice, and the closing sentence ('these equalities respect identities, composition of u and addition of exponents') could not be checked. tau^(b) is now defined once, through the relative Frobenius maps r^(b), and the closing sentence is replaced by the precise additivity tau^(b1+b2) = tau^(b2) ∘ tau^(b1)L(F^b2)^* ∘ c. (2) E5 in item step 5: the coherence of pullback-composition isomorphisms was hidden behind 'the identity and composition compatibilities are those in the same lemma'. Step 5 now gives it from the termwise description in lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition, cites that node, and has elementary=false. Accepted tool use: lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition (it is in fact on the route).; 2 file(s) fixed by the reviewer

lean.note: The main declaration constructs the specified kappa composite from the normalized relative-Frobenius trivialization and exact descended composition comparison. The listed helpers expose both actual base-changed schemes and maps, both arithmetic factorizations, both square identifications and the full equality of natural transformations. No absolute finite-type hypothesis is imposed.
